{"parentUuid":"e8fd2711-ea84-44ae-bd7e-ec3d07c1acf7","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"da29abb0-dcc3-4276-85df-23b65c5f4666","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0198akhf32gshaz1fKv3RsAj","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# Client brief: Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC)\n2\t\n3\t## About the club\n4\t\n5\tThe Kenyon College Finance Club is a student organization founded in 2019 that helps students explore finance and prepare for opportunities in the field. The club offers stock pitches, trading competitions, speaker events, resume workshops, and an Analyst Program for newer members. Its alumni network also connects students with people working at banks and investment firms and has helped members find employment opportunities.\n6\t\n7\tThis year, the club has three presidents: **Aishik Biswas, Lucas Flynn, and Madeline Ha**. The three of us organize the club's activities and coordinate its meetings and events. We meet **every other week in Oden 110**, and our primary means of communication is the club email, **financeclub@kenyon.edu**. Students can also fill out forms to request a resume review.\n8\t\n9\tOne of our main events is the spring stock pitch competition. Members work in three groups, each covering a different sector and led by one of the three presidents. The groups then present their pitches to Kenyon alumni working in equity research at **William Blair**. This gives members an opportunity to apply what they have learned and receive feedback from people working in the industry.\n10\t\n11\t## Who would manage the website\n12\t\n13\tThe website needs to reflect how the club is actually organized. Since the three presidents share responsibility for running the club, all three should have administrator access. This would allow us to update official club information, maintain the Leadership and Analyst Program pages, and manage accounts for other officers.\n14\t\n15\tOther officers should be able to contribute event announcements, stock pitch writeups, recruiting resources, and alumni event recaps. These contributions should be straightforward to create and update, without requiring someone to learn a complicated editing system. The presidents would remain responsible for managing access and reviewing material that represents the club publicly.\n16\t\n17\tThe website also needs to be manageable when leadership changes. Each incoming officer should receive an individual account with the appropriate permissions, and outgoing officers should lose access when their responsibilities end. This would make the transition less dependent on a shared password or on one person knowing how the website works.\n18\t\n19\t## Who would use the website\n20\t\n21\t- **Prospective members**, especially first-years and sophomores, would want to understand what the club does, whether they need prior experience, and when and where meetings take place.\n22\t- **Current members** would use it to find event details, recruiting resources, resume review forms, and information about the Analyst Program and spring stock pitch competition.\n23\t- **Alumni and recruiters** would use it to learn about the club's leadership and activities before speaking at an event, reviewing a pitch, or helping a student with recruiting.\n24\t\n25\t## Problems with the current website\n26\t\n27\tThe current Wix website, financeclub15.wixsite.com, does not adequately represent the club's activities. It has no current officers, meeting times, or event announcements listed, and the Contact Us link leads back to the homepage. The Resources section contains headings without material beneath them. For someone unfamiliar with the club, this could suggest that it is no longer active.\n28\t\n29\tMost of our current information is communicated through email. While this works for announcements and direct communication, it also means that members have to look through earlier messages to find meeting details or resources. The website could provide a consistent place to access that information, alongside links to forms such as the resume review request form.\n30\t\n31\tUpdating the site is also difficult when only one or two people have access. A system that allows officers to contribute within clearly defined roles would make regular updates more manageable. The Wix subdomain and advertising banner also limit how professionally the club presents itself to alumni and prospective members.\n32\t\n33\t## What an improved website should provide\n34\t\n35\t- A simple way for officers to create event announcements, ideally in under two minutes.\n36\t- A homepage that clearly displays our meeting schedule, location, contact email, and upcoming events.\n37\t- Accessible links to resume review forms and relevant recruiting resources.\n38\t- An archive of reviewed stock pitches and alumni event recaps that future members can learn from.\n39\t- Individual accounts and clear permissions, with an uncomplicated process for transferring responsibility to new leadership.\n40\t\n41\t## Access and publishing requirements\n42\t\n43\t- **Draft stock pitches must remain private until they have been reviewed.** Since members present their work to alumni, material published under the club's name should be complete and checked.\n44\t- **Only the three presidents, as administrators, should be able to edit or delete the Leadership and Analyst Program pages.** Other officers can contribute content without having control over these official pages.\n45\t- **Outgoing officers should no longer be able to log in once their roles end.** Access should reflect a person's current responsibilities within the club.\n46\t- **Only the presidents should be able to create accounts or change user roles.** These restrictions need to be enforced by the system, including when someone attempts to access a restricted page directly.\n47\t"}]},"uuid":"5e79356d-2cb7-4e58-b3e6-3f0eddc6e9d6","timestamp":"2026-10-15T02:33:04.967Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/notes/client-brief.md","content":"# Client brief: Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC)\n\n## About the club\n\nThe Kenyon College Finance Club is a student organization founded in 2019 that helps students explore finance and prepare for opportunities in the field. The club offers stock pitches, trading competitions, speaker events, resume workshops, and an Analyst Program for newer members. Its alumni network also connects students with people working at banks and investment firms and has helped members find employment opportunities.\n\nThis year, the club has three presidents: **Aishik Biswas, Lucas Flynn, and Madeline Ha**. The three of us organize the club's activities and coordinate its meetings and events. We meet **every other week in Oden 110**, and our primary means of communication is the club email, **financeclub@kenyon.edu**. Students can also fill out forms to request a resume review.\n\nOne of our main events is the spring stock pitch competition. Members work in three groups, each covering a different sector and led by one of the three presidents. The groups then present their pitches to Kenyon alumni working in equity research at **William Blair**. This gives members an opportunity to apply what they have learned and receive feedback from people working in the industry.\n\n## Who would manage the website\n\nThe website needs to reflect how the club is actually organized. Since the three presidents share responsibility for running the club, all three should have administrator access. This would allow us to update official club information, maintain the Leadership and Analyst Program pages, and manage accounts for other officers.\n\nOther officers should be able to contribute event announcements, stock pitch writeups, recruiting resources, and alumni event recaps. These contributions should be straightforward to create and update, without requiring someone to learn a complicated editing system. The presidents would remain responsible for managing access and reviewing material that represents the club publicly.\n\nThe website also needs to be manageable when leadership changes. Each incoming officer should receive an individual account with the appropriate permissions, and outgoing officers should lose access when their responsibilities end. This would make the transition less dependent on a shared password or on one person knowing how the website works.\n\n## Who would use the website\n\n- **Prospective members**, especially first-years and sophomores, would want to understand what the club does, whether they need prior experience, and when and where meetings take place.\n- **Current members** would use it to find event details, recruiting resources, resume review forms, and information about the Analyst Program and spring stock pitch competition.\n- **Alumni and recruiters** would use it to learn about the club's leadership and activities before speaking at an event, reviewing a pitch, or helping a student with recruiting.\n\n## Problems with the current website\n\nThe current Wix website, financeclub15.wixsite.com, does not adequately represent the club's activities. It has no current officers, meeting times, or event announcements listed, and the Contact Us link leads back to the homepage. The Resources section contains headings without material beneath them. For someone unfamiliar with the club, this could suggest that it is no longer active.\n\nMost of our current information is communicated through email. While this works for announcements and direct communication, it also means that members have to look through earlier messages to find meeting details or resources. The website could provide a consistent place to access that information, alongside links to forms such as the resume review request form.\n\nUpdating the site is also difficult when only one or two people have access. A system that allows officers to contribute within clearly defined roles would make regular updates more manageable. The Wix subdomain and advertising banner also limit how professionally the club presents itself to alumni and prospective members.\n\n## What an improved website should provide\n\n- A simple way for officers to create event announcements, ideally in under two minutes.\n- A homepage that clearly displays our meeting schedule, location, contact email, and upcoming events.\n- Accessible links to resume review forms and relevant recruiting resources.\n- An archive of reviewed stock pitches and alumni event recaps that future members can learn from.\n- Individual accounts and clear permissions, with an uncomplicated process for transferring responsibility to new leadership.\n\n## Access and publishing requirements\n\n- **Draft stock pitches must remain private until they have been reviewed.** Since members present their work to alumni, material published under the club's name should be complete and checked.\n- **Only the three presidents, as administrators, should be able to edit or delete the Leadership and Analyst Program pages.** Other officers can contribute content without having control over these official pages.\n- **Outgoing officers should no longer be able to log in once their roles end.** Access should reflect a person's current responsibilities within the club.\n- **Only the presidents should be able to create accounts or change user roles.** These restrictions need to be enforced by the system, including when someone attempts to access a restricted page directly.\n","numLines":47,"startLine":1,"totalLines":47}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e8fd2711-ea84-44ae-bd7e-ec3d07c1acf7","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"b5382908-f13c-4109-b1c9-947f3c14cf98","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3EtZ7pqzUuoAhCo2T1o","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I read both notes and Part 3.3. The notes already settle a few things, and I'll treat these as settled unless you object:\n- Drafts never appear on the public site.\n- Only the three presidents manage users.\n- Officers write Markdown, not a rich-text editor.\n\n`CONTEXT.md` is an empty stub, so I'll write terms there as you settle them. `GLOSSARY.md` is also an empty stub, and your CLAUDE.md says never to use that name, so I'll leave it alone.\n\n❓ **Q1 - What an Editor can do:** Capability 2 requires *admin* and *editor* to have genuinely different permissions. Your brief says the presidents review anything that \"represents the club publicly,\" and that draft stock pitches stay private until reviewed. I propose this split:\n\n- **Admin** (the three presidents) can do everything. That means create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage users.\n- **Editor** (other officers) can create and edit **Posts** and save them as **drafts**. They can't publish, can't delete a published Post, can't touch **Pages** at all (Leadership, Analyst Program, About), and can't see user management.\n\nUnder this split a president is the one who flips a draft to published, so \"reviewed\" is enforced by the system and not by habit.\n\n➡️ Yes: Editors write Posts and save drafts only, and only Admins publish, manage Pages, and manage users."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":383,"cache_read_input_tokens":56213,"output_tokens":1280,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":817},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":383,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1280,"cache_read_input_tokens":56213,"cache_creation_input_tokens":383,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":383},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011Cg3EtYoxok79nLQHdUPY4","requestedModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","attributionSkill":"domain-modeling","type":"assistant","uuid":"543a5f6c-ffe4-4c35-92c1-b1727546ca40","timestamp":"2026-10-15T02:33:23.148Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, and the Analyst Program. Only Admins may change a Page.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site.\n\n**Published**: A Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":265,"cache_read_input_tokens":57913,"output_tokens":481,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":265,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":481,"cache_read_input_tokens":57913,"cache_creation_input_tokens":265,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":265},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01NvYPud7HGkEhUKX7pksK8n":{"file_path":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","content":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, and the Analyst Program. Only Admins may change a Page.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Kind**: The category every Post has exactly one of: `announcement`, `pitch`, `recap`, or `recruiting`. The public site lists each Kind separately.\n\n**Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor).\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, and the Analyst Program. Only Admins may change a Page.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site.\n\n**Published**: A Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":20,"oldLines":7,"newStart":20,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," **Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor)."," ","-**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, and the Analyst Program. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**:","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Kind**: The category every Post has exactly one of: `announcement`, `pitch`, `recap`, or `recruiting`. The public site lists each Kind separately.\n\n**Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor).\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). Only Admins may change a Page.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site.\n\n**Published**: A Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":22,"oldLines":6,"newStart":22,"newLines":8,"lines":[" "," **Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). {"parentUuid":"d73beaf2-15aa-4bd4-96ba-80877859bc0e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3FSPehdF5HDUonWPQze","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I added Slug to `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n❓ **Q5 - Leadership turnover:** Your brief wants outgoing officers to lose access, with no shared passwords. Capability 6 says a deactivated user can't log in. I propose three rules:\n\n- **Deactivate, never delete.** An outgoing Officer's account is switched off. Their Posts keep their name as author, so the archive stays accurate.\n- **Reactivation is allowed.** An Admin can turn a User back on, for an Officer who returns to the club.\n- **Immediate effect.** If a deactivated User is signed in at that moment, their next action is refused and they're signed out.\n\nWhen a new President takes over, an Admin changes that User's Role to Admin. The last active Admin can't be deactivated or demoted, so the club can't lock itself out.\n\n➡️ Yes: deactivate and never delete, allow reactivation, take effect immediately, and always keep at least one active Admin."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":303,"cache_read_input_tokens":60739,"output_tokens":315,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":303,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":315,"cache_read_input_tokens":60739,"cache_creation_input_tokens":303,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":303},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011Cg3FSPN5xdC1BYi5RJiki","requestedModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"3a2b7f37-701e-4133-8d3a-0305c1a0dad3","timestamp":"2026-10-15T02:40:27.040Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

The last active Admin cannot be deactivated or demoted.\n\n## Content","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Kind**: The category every Post has exactly one of: `announcement`, `pitch`, `recap`, or `recruiting`. The public site lists each Kind separately.\n\n**Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor).\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). Only Admins may change a Page.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site.\n\n**Published**: A Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":12,"oldLines":6,"newStart":12,"newLines":10,"lines":[" "," **Editor**: The role held by Officers. {"parentUuid":"ff9411dd-bca3-448b-9b17-68988a2d05a8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3FVbY9jbiFcF4ZRxLdt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I added User and Deactivated to `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n❓ **Q6 - Publishing and the admin console:** Your CLAUDE.md says the admin console runs locally and never goes on the public internet. Then `cms publish` writes the static `site/`, which goes to GitHub Pages. That raises a practical question: where do Officers write their Posts? I propose:\n\n- The console runs on **one club laptop** (a President's). Officers sit down at it, or a President lets them in, and sign in with their own account.\n- **Publish** is the step that regenerates `site/` from Published content and deploys it to GitHub Pages. Only an Admin runs it.\n- Marking a Post \"published\" in the console doesn't put it on the public site by itself. It goes live at the next Publish. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Never shared between people.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. The last active Admin cannot be deactivated or demoted.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Kind**: The category every Post has exactly one of: `announcement`, `pitch`, `recap`, or `recruiting`. The public site lists each Kind separately.\n\n**Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor).\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). Only Admins may change a Page.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site.\n\n**Published**: A Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":14,"oldLines":7,"newStart":14,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," **User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Never shared between people.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Kind**: The category every Post has exactly one of: `announcement`, `pitch`, `recap`, or `recruiting`. The public site lists each Kind separately.\n\n**Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor).\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). Only Admins may change a Page.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site.\n\n**Published**: The status of a Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site. Approved is not the same as Live.\n\n**Publish run**: Running `cms publish`, which only an Admin does. It rebuilds the public site from everything Published and deploys it.\n\n**Live**: On the public site as of the last Publish run. A Published item becomes Live only at the next Publish run.\n\n**Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live.\n\n**Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. The console is never on the public internet; Officers sign in on it with their own accounts.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":28,"oldLines":7,"newStart":28,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," **Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Only Admins may create, edit or delete a Page; Editors cannot touch them at all.\n\n**Homepage**: A Page edited by Admins. The next meeting (every other week, Oden 110) is the first thing a visitor sees, followed by the contact email and the latest Announcements.\n\n**Navigation**: The public menu. It lists Published Pages in an order an Admin sets, plus fixed links to the Post listings.\n\n**Event**: Not a separate thing. An event is an Announcement Post.\n\n**Listing**: A public list of Posts of one Kind, newest first.","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Never shared between people.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Kind**: The category every Post has exactly one of: `announcement`, `pitch`, `recap`, or `recruiting`. The public site lists each Kind separately.\n\n**Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor).\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). Only Admins may change a Page.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site. A Published Post returns to Draft when an Editor edits it, and stays out of the public site until an Admin publishes it again. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.\n\n**Published**: The status of a Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site. Approved is not the same as Live.\n\n**Publish run**: Running `cms publish`, which only an Admin does. It rebuilds the public site from everything Published and deploys it.\n\n**Live**: On the public site as of the last Publish run. A Published item becomes Live only at the next Publish run.\n\n**Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live.\n\n**Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. The console is never on the public internet; Officers sign in on it with their own accounts.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":24,"oldLines":8,"newStart":24,"newLines":16,"lines":[" "," **Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor)."," ","-**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). There is no members-only content.","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Never shared between people.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Kind**: The category every Post has exactly one of: `announcement`, `pitch`, `recap`, or `recruiting`. The public site lists each Kind separately.\n\n**Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor).\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, Join, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). Only Admins may create, edit or delete a Page; Editors cannot touch them at all.\n\n**Homepage**: A Page edited by Admins. The next meeting (every other week, Oden 110) is the first thing a visitor sees, followed by the contact email and the latest Announcements.\n\n**Navigation**: The public menu. It lists Published Pages in an order an Admin sets, plus fixed links to the Post listings.\n\n**Event**: Not a separate thing. An event is an Announcement Post.\n\n**Listing**: A public list of Posts of one Kind, newest first.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site. A Published Post returns to Draft when an Editor edits it, and stays out of the public site until an Admin publishes it again. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.\n\n**Published**: The status of a Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site. Approved is not the same as Live.\n\n**Publish run**: Running `cms publish`, which only an Admin does. It rebuilds the public site from everything Published and deploys it.\n\n**Live**: On the public site as of the last Publish run. A Published item becomes Live only at the next Publish run.\n\n**Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live.\n\n**Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. The console is never on the public internet; Officers sign in on it with their own accounts.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":12,"oldLines":8,"newStart":12,"newLines":10,"lines":[" "," **Editor**: The role held by Officers. Kept separate from the Join Page (one Page, one audience).\n\n**Homepage**:","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Only Presidents and Officers are Users. Never shared between people.\n\n**Visitor**: Anyone reading the public site: prospective members, current members, alumni, recruiters. Visitors never log in, and everything on the public site is visible to all of them. There is no members-only content.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Kind**: The category every Post has exactly one of: `announcement`, `pitch`, `recap`, or `recruiting`. The public site lists each Kind separately.\n\n**Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor).\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, Join, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). Only Admins may create, edit or delete a Page; Editors cannot touch them at all.\n\n**Homepage**: A Page edited by Admins. The next meeting (every other week, Oden 110) is the first thing a visitor sees, followed by the contact email and the latest Announcements.\n\n**Navigation**: The public menu. It lists Published Pages in an order an Admin sets, plus fixed links to the Post listings.\n\n**Event**: Not a separate thing. An event is an Announcement Post.\n\n**Listing**: A public list of Posts of one Kind, newest first.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site. A Published Post returns to Draft when an Editor edits it, and stays out of the public site until an Admin publishes it again. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.\n\n**Published**: The status of a Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site. Approved is not the same as Live.\n\n**Publish run**: Running `cms publish`, which only an Admin does. It rebuilds the public site from everything Published and deploys it.\n\n**Live**: On the public site as of the last Publish run. A Published item becomes Live only at the next Publish run.\n\n**Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live.\n\n**Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. The console is never on the public internet; Officers sign in on it with their own accounts.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":28,"oldLines":6,"newStart":28,"newLines":10,"lines":[" "," **Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, Join, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). {"parentUuid":"d472aa20-25a4-4308-8102-3f9ba1bbffed","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3FsEAPKraQAZx6TfES9","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I'll keep Join and Recruiting as two Pages, since a Page with one purpose is easier for a first-year to find in Navigation. I added both to `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n❓ **Q10 - What Markdown may contain:** The rule is that user-written Markdown is sanitized before it's shown. For KCFC, officers need headings, bold, lists, and links, such as the resume form link. A stock pitch writeup might also want a chart or image. {"parentUuid":"fdcd5d4c-df1a-400f-95c0-c8b07e3be28a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3Fw839yrnoTQ46anAaZ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013j4NE3Rg1xs4iAM81vmYYD","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","content":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Only Presidents and Officers are Users. Never shared between people.\n\n**Visitor**: Anyone reading the public site: prospective members, current members, alumni, recruiters. Visitors never log in, and everything on the public site is visible to all of them. There is no members-only content.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: The one kind of dated club material: a meeting announcement, a pitch writeup, or an alumni call recap. There is a single kind of Post and no categories.\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information: About, Leadership, Analyst Program, Join, Recruiting. Only Admins may create, edit or delete a Page; Editors cannot touch them at all.\n\n**Join Page**: The Page for prospective members: what the club does, whether prior experience is needed, how to come to a meeting.\n\n**Recruiting Page**: The Page for current members: the resume review form link and standing guides. Kept separate from the Join Page (one Page, one audience).\n\n**Homepage**: A Page edited by Admins. The next meeting (every other week, Oden 110) is the first thing a Visitor sees, followed by the contact email and the latest Posts.\n\n**Navigation**: The public menu. It lists Published Pages in an order an Admin sets, plus a link to the Posts listing.\n\n**Posts listing**: The public list of Published Posts, newest first.\n\n**Event**: Not a separate thing. An event is announced in a Post.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site. A Published Post returns to Draft when an Editor edits it, and stays out of the public site until an Admin publishes it again. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.\n\n**Published**: The status of a Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site. Approved is not the same as Live.\n\n**Publish run**: Running `cms publish`, which only an Admin does. It rebuilds the public site from everything Published and deploys it.\n\n**Live**: On the public site as of the last Publish run. A Published item becomes Live only at the next Publish run.\n\n**Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live.\n\n**Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. The console is never on the public internet; Officers sign in on it with their own accounts.\n\n## Out of scope\n\nComments, image uploads, categories, scheduled posts, email newsletters, member logins.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":114,"cache_read_input_tokens":67491,"output_tokens":1732,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":396},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":114,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1732,"cache_read_input_tokens":67491,"cache_creation_input_tokens":114,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":114},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_013j4NE3Rg1xs4iAM81vmYYD":{"file_path":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","content":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"2662a9ed-b4de-4c0a-a8e4-fe73f874c9a7","timestamp":"2026-10-15T02:47:03.939Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"update","filePath":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","content":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Only Presidents and Officers are Users. Never shared between people.\n\n**Visitor**: Anyone reading the public site: prospective members, current members, alumni, recruiters. Visitors never log in, and everything on the public site is visible to all of them. There is no members-only content.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: The one kind of dated club material: a meeting announcement, a pitch writeup, or an alumni call recap. There is a single kind of Post and no categories.\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information: About, Leadership, Analyst Program, Join, Recruiting. Only Admins may create, edit or delete a Page; Editors cannot touch them at all.\n\n**Join Page**: The Page for prospective members: what the club does, whether prior experience is needed, how to come to a meeting.\n\n**Recruiting Page**: The Page for current members: the resume review form link and standing guides. Kept separate from the Join Page (one Page, one audience).\n\n**Homepage**: A Page edited by Admins. The next meeting (every other week, Oden 110) is the first thing a Visitor sees, followed by the contact email and the latest Posts.\n\n**Navigation**: The public menu. It lists Published Pages in an order an Admin sets, plus a link to the Posts listing.\n\n**Posts listing**: The public list of Published Posts, newest first.\n\n**Event**: Not a separate thing. An event is announced in a Post.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site. A Published Post returns to Draft when an Editor edits it, and stays out of the public site until an Admin publishes it again. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.\n\n**Published**: The status of a Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site. Approved is not the same as Live.\n\n**Publish run**: Running `cms publish`, which only an Admin does. It rebuilds the public site from everything Published and deploys it.\n\n**Live**: On the public site as of the last Publish run. A Published item becomes Live only at the next Publish run.\n\n**Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live.\n\n**Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. The console is never on the public internet; Officers sign in on it with their own accounts.\n\n## Out of scope\n\nComments, image uploads, categories, scheduled posts, email newsletters, member logins.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":20,"oldLines":25,"newStart":20,"newLines":21,"lines":[" "," ## Content"," ","-**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.","+**Post**: The one kind of dated club material: a meeting announcement, a pitch writeup, or an alumni call recap. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Only Presidents and Officers are Users. Never shared between people.\n\n**Visitor**: Anyone reading the public site: prospective members, current members, alumni, recruiters. Visitors never log in, and everything on the public site is visible to all of them. There is no members-only content.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: Dated club material such as a meeting announcement, event recap, or stock pitch writeup.\n\n**Kind**: The category every Post has exactly one of: `announcement`, `pitch`, `recap`, or `recruiting`. The public site lists each Kind separately.\n\n**Recruiting Post**: A Post of Kind `recruiting`: dated recruiting updates, tips and tricks, and **job openings** (openings at firms; never called \"roles\", since Role means Admin or Editor).\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information such as About, Leadership, the Analyst Program, Join, and Recruiting (the resume review form link and standing guides). Only Admins may create, edit or delete a Page; Editors cannot touch them at all.\n\n**Join Page**: The Page for prospective members: what the club does, whether prior experience is needed, how to come to a meeting.\n\n**Recruiting Page**: The Page for current members: the resume review form link and standing guides, linking to the Recruiting Posts. Kept separate from the Join Page (one Page, one audience).\n\n**Homepage**: A Page edited by Admins. The next meeting (every other week, Oden 110) is the first thing a visitor sees, followed by the contact email and the latest Announcements.\n\n**Navigation**: The public menu. It lists Published Pages in an order an Admin sets, plus fixed links to the Post listings.\n\n**Event**: Not a separate thing. An event is an Announcement Post.\n\n**Listing**: A public list of Posts of one Kind, newest first.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site. A Published Post returns to Draft when an Editor edits it, and stays out of the public site until an Admin publishes it again. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.\n\n**Published**: The status of a Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site. Approved is not the same as Live.\n\n**Publish run**: Running `cms publish`, which only an Admin does. It rebuilds the public site from everything Published and deploys it.\n\n**Live**: On the public site as of the last Publish run. A Published item becomes Live only at the next Publish run.\n\n**Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live.\n\n**Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. The console is never on the public internet; Officers sign in on it with their own accounts.\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f01d418b-7e7d-4a25-8dc1-20921d02b623","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

Admins hand-link standout archive Posts from the Recruiting Page.","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Only Presidents and Officers are Users. Never shared between people.\n\n**Visitor**: Anyone reading the public site: prospective members, current members, alumni, recruiters. Visitors never log in, and everything on the public site is visible to all of them. There is no members-only content.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: The one kind of dated club material: a meeting announcement, a pitch writeup, or an alumni call recap. There is a single kind of Post and no categories.\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information: About, Leadership, Analyst Program, Join, Recruiting. Only Admins may create, edit or delete a Page; Editors cannot touch them at all.\n\n**Join Page**: The Page for prospective members: what the club does, whether prior experience is needed, how to come to a meeting.\n\n**Recruiting Page**: The Page for current members: the resume review form link and standing guides. Kept separate from the Join Page (one Page, one audience).\n\n**Homepage**: A Page edited by Admins. The next meeting (every other week, Oden 110) is the first thing a Visitor sees, followed by the contact email and the latest Posts.\n\n**Navigation**: The public menu. It lists Published Pages in an order an Admin sets, plus a link to the Posts listing.\n\n**Posts listing**: The public list of Published Posts, newest first.\n\n**Event**: Not a separate thing. An event is announced in a Post.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site. A Published Post returns to Draft when an Editor edits it, and stays out of the public site until an Admin publishes it again. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.\n\n**Published**: The status of a Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site. Approved is not the same as Live.\n\n**Publish run**: Running `cms publish`, which only an Admin does. It rebuilds the public site from everything Published and deploys it.\n\n**Live**: On the public site as of the last Publish run. A Published item becomes Live only at the next Publish run.\n\n**Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live.\n\n**Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. The console is never on the public internet; Officers sign in on it with their own accounts.\n\n## Out of scope\n\nComments, image uploads, categories, scheduled posts, email newsletters, member logins.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":32,"oldLines":8,"newStart":32,"newLines":10,"lines":[" "," **Navigation**: The public menu. {"parentUuid":"f7450475-8e44-4a44-bd32-804aa550c851","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3G27a1af4skfymGfv9Y","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I added the Title convention to `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n❓ **Q12 - Taking things down and deleting:** Capability 3 includes delete, so the system needs rules. I propose:\n\n- **Unpublish is separate from delete.** An Admin can return a Published Post or Page to Draft, so it leaves the public site at the next Publish run but is kept for later.\n- **Delete is permanent,** and an Admin asks for it with an \"are you sure?\" step. Only an Admin can delete a Published Post or any Page.\n- **Editors can delete only their own Drafts.** That covers abandoned or test Posts without giving them any reach over published work.\n- **Deleted items leave the site at the next Publish run,** the same as any other change.\n\n➡️ Yes: unpublish is separate from delete, Admins can delete anything after a confirm step, and Editors can delete only their own Drafts."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":620,"cache_read_input_tokens":69880,"output_tokens":292,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":620,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":292,"cache_read_input_tokens":69880,"cache_creation_input_tokens":620,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":620},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011Cg3G27JtDbaBX5JqgAVR6","requestedModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"f9c67b1d-84f1-427d-a88a-04772b935043","timestamp":"2026-10-15T02:48:04.410Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

Users are never deleted, only Deactivated (for example when seniors graduate in May: their old Posts keep their name, but they cannot log in).\n\n**Draft**: A Post","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Only Presidents and Officers are Users. Never shared between people.\n\n**Visitor**: Anyone reading the public site: prospective members, current members, alumni, recruiters. Visitors never log in, and everything on the public site is visible to all of them. There is no members-only content.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: The one kind of dated club material: a meeting announcement, a pitch writeup, or an alumni call recap. There is a single kind of Post and no categories.\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information: About, Leadership, Analyst Program, Join, Recruiting. Only Admins may create, edit or delete a Page; Editors cannot touch them at all.\n\n**Join Page**: The Page for prospective members: what the club does, whether prior experience is needed, how to come to a meeting.\n\n**Recruiting Page**: The Page for current members: the resume review form link and standing guides. Kept separate from the Join Page (one Page, one audience).\n\n**Homepage**: A Page edited by Admins. The next meeting (every other week, Oden 110) is the first thing a Visitor sees, followed by the contact email and the latest Posts.\n\n**Navigation**: The public menu. It lists Published Pages in an order an Admin sets, plus a link to the Posts listing.\n\n**Posts listing**: The public list of Published Posts, newest first, showing title and date.\n\n**Title convention**: A club habit, not enforced by the system: Post titles for pitches and recaps start with \"Pitch:\" or \"Recap:\" (e.g. \"Pitch: NVDA, Spring 2026\") so the Posts listing is scannable. Admins hand-link standout archive Posts from the Recruiting Page.\n\n**Event**: Not a separate thing. An event is announced in a Post.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site. A Published Post returns to Draft when an Editor edits it, and stays out of the public site until an Admin publishes it again. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.\n\n**Published**: The status of a Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site. Approved is not the same as Live.\n\n**Publish run**: Running `cms publish`, which only an Admin does. It rebuilds the public site from everything Published and deploys it.\n\n**Live**: On the public site as of the last Publish run. A Published item becomes Live only at the next Publish run.\n\n**Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live.\n\n**Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. The console is never on the public internet; Officers sign in on it with their own accounts.\n\n## Out of scope\n\nComments, image uploads, categories, scheduled posts, email newsletters, member logins.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":40,"oldLines":6,"newStart":40,"newLines":10,"lines":[" "," **Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Editors see Posts only.\n\n**Preview**: The editor's side-by-side view of how the sanitized Markdown will look on the public site, labelled \"Draft, not Live\" when it is not.\n\n**Club laptop**:","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nProject vocabulary for the Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) website. One word per concept; if a better word appears, change it here.\n\n## People and roles\n\n**President**: One of the three students who run KCFC. Every President holds the Admin role.\n\n**Officer**: A club member other than a President who helps run the club. Every Officer holds the Editor role while in office.\n\n**Admin**: The role held by the three Presidents. Can create, edit, publish and delete Posts and Pages, and manage Users.\n\n**Editor**: The role held by Officers. Can create and edit Posts and save them as Drafts. Cannot publish, cannot delete a published Post, cannot touch Pages, and cannot see User management.\n\n**User**: Anyone with an individual account on the admin console. Only Presidents and Officers are Users. Never shared between people.\n\n**Visitor**: Anyone reading the public site: prospective members, current members, alumni, recruiters. Visitors never log in, and everything on the public site is visible to all of them. There is no members-only content.\n\n**Deactivated**: A User switched off by an Admin when their time in office ends. They can no longer sign in, and any open session ends at their next action. Their Posts keep their name as author. An Admin can reactivate them. Users are never deleted. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**: The one kind of dated club material: a meeting announcement, a pitch writeup, or an alumni call recap. There is a single kind of Post and no categories.\n\n**Page**: Lasting club information: About, Leadership, Analyst Program, Join, Recruiting. Only Admins may create, edit or delete a Page; Editors cannot touch them at all.\n\n**Join Page**: The Page for prospective members: what the club does, whether prior experience is needed, how to come to a meeting.\n\n**Recruiting Page**: The Page for current members: the resume review form link and standing guides. Kept separate from the Join Page (one Page, one audience).\n\n**Homepage**: A Page edited by Admins. The next meeting (every other week, Oden 110) is the first thing a Visitor sees, followed by the contact email and the latest Posts.\n\n**Navigation**: The public menu. It lists Published Pages in an order an Admin sets, plus a link to the Posts listing.\n\n**Posts listing**: The public list of Published Posts, newest first, showing title and date.\n\n**Title convention**: A club habit, not enforced by the system: Post titles for pitches and recaps start with \"Pitch:\" or \"Recap:\" (e.g. \"Pitch: NVDA, Spring 2026\") so the Posts listing is scannable. Admins hand-link standout archive Posts from the Recruiting Page.\n\n**Event**: Not a separate thing. An event is announced in a Post.\n\n**Slug**: The short address-name of a Post or Page (e.g. `spring-stock-pitch`). Made from the title once, when first saved, and unchanged when the title is edited. Only an Admin can edit it; an old slug is not redirected.\n\n**Unpublish**: An Admin returns a Published Post or Page to Draft. It leaves the public site at the next Publish run but is kept.\n\n**Delete**: Permanent removal of a Post or Page, after an \"are you sure?\" step. Only an Admin can delete a Published Post or any Page; an Editor can delete only their own Drafts. Users are never deleted, only Deactivated (for example when seniors graduate in May: their old Posts keep their name, but they cannot log in).\n\n**Draft**: A Post that has been saved but not published. Visible only to signed-in Users, never on the public site. A Published Post returns to Draft when an Editor edits it, and stays out of the public site until an Admin publishes it again. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.\n\n**Published**: The status of a Post or Page that an Admin has approved for the public site. Approved is not the same as Live.\n\n**Publish run**: Running `cms publish`, which only an Admin does. It rebuilds the public site from everything Published and deploys it.\n\n**Live**: On the public site as of the last Publish run. A Published item becomes Live only at the next Publish run.\n\n**Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live.\n\n**Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. The console is never on the public internet; Officers sign in on it with their own accounts.\n\n## Out of scope\n\nComments, image uploads, categories, scheduled posts, email newsletters, member logins.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":54,"oldLines":6,"newStart":54,"newLines":12,"lines":[" "," **Pending changes**: Changes made since the last Publish run, which the console shows in a banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live."," ","+**Dashboard**: The console's first screen. Shows counts of Drafts, Published items and Pending changes (Admins also see active and Deactivated Users), and a one-click \"New Post\" button.","+","+**Content list**: The console's list of Posts and Pages, newest first, filterable by status (with counts) and type. Editors see Posts only.","+","+**Preview**: The editor's side-by-side view of how the sanitized Markdown will look on the public site, labelled \"Draft, not Live\" when it is not.","+"," **Club laptop**: The one computer that runs the admin console. {"parentUuid":"e7fd5b8f-8f69-45f5-942d-6f87d517a42d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3GDWpKA3jwsGPdaVYUZ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I added Dashboard, Content list and Preview to `CONTEXT.md`. I called the quick-start button \"New Post,\" since there's only one kind of Post now.\n\n❓ **Q14 - Signing in, and lost passwords:** Capability 1 requires hashed passwords and sign in and out. Your brief wants no shared passwords and easy turnover. The club has no email server for the console, so I propose:\n\n- **Sign in** with an email address (the person's Kenyon address) and a password.\n- **New accounts:** an Admin creates the User and sets a temporary password. The User must choose their own password at first sign-in.\n- **Lost password:** there's no self-service reset, because the console has no way to send email. An Admin sets a new temporary password in person, and the User chooses their own again.\n- **Sessions** end on sign-out or after a set idle time, so a signed-in console left on the club laptop doesn't stay open for the next person.\n\n➡️ Yes: email plus password, Admin-set temporary passwords that must be changed at first sign-in, Admin-assisted resets, and an idle sign-out."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":503,"cache_read_input_tokens":71895,"output_tokens":357,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":503,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":357,"cache_read_input_tokens":71895,"cache_creation_input_tokens":503,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":503},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011Cg3GDWRVxmwu2Bd7mViHQ","requestedModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"bb37cbea-d404-43b7-86ba-cd162a45bc69","timestamp":"2026-10-15T02:50:39.544Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"1f55456e-90f6-400c-9426-32a9b2b270a9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}
